team.abilityDesc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack and Sp. Atk stats but lowers its accuracy.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.desc: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.desc: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

team.abilityDesc: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.desc: This attack move's power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.desc: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger to inflict damage. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.desc: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.

team.abilityDesc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's move if it is the last to act that turn.

moves.name: Electro Ball
moves.desc: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Magnet Bomb
moves.desc: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special moves for five turns.
mechanics: Levanta Pantalla de Luz (reduce el daño especial del equipo)

moves.name: Flash
moves.desc: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's accuracy.
